components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.Telephone"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last
            name and address (i.e. they knowingly share a household). Write-only; never persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Stable code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household id
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners that knowingly share a household (same last name and address). Assigned only when an owner joins an existing household via 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-0A1B2C3D4E5F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Stable code formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation: starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived on read as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-0A1B2C3D4E5F'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the optional `postcode` field for owners, satisfying the spec and all tests.

**What the feature does:** an owner may include a 4-digit `postcode`. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit code. Out-of-range or malformed postcodes are rejected with 400. When absent, the owner is still accepted (backward-compatible). The value is stored and returned.

**Changes, each in the unit where it belongs:**

- **`openapi.yml`** — added the optional `postcode` property to the `OwnerFields` schema (so it's accepted on write and returned on read via the `Owner` `allOf`), plus a class-level `@ValidPostcode` annotation via `x-class-extra-annotation`.
- **`PostcodeRule`** (new) — the single home for postcode-validity logic: 4-digit shape check + region-range lookup. It *reuses* the existing `LocalityResolver` for city→region mapping rather than duplicating the table.
- **`ValidPostcode`** + **`PostcodeValidator`** (new) — a thin class-level Bean Validation constraint (needed because validity depends on both `city` and `postcode`), following the existing `Telephone`/`PetAge` validator pattern. It delegates to `PostcodeRule` and reports the violation on the `postcode` property.
- **`Owner`** — added the `postcode` column/getter/setter alongside the other simple fields.
- **DB schemas** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `postcode` column.

MapStruct maps `postcode` automatically by name in both directions, so no mapper changes were needed. Full suite: **3 run, 0 failures**.
